facts.business: Desi Farms India Limited (formerly SER Industries Limited) was primarily engaged in logistics and transportation during FY 2025-26, while undertaking a strategic realignment to enter the dairy, milk and allied food products sector through acquisitions of SNA Milk and Milk Products Limited and DFSU Farmer Connect Private Limited.

auditor.name: ANKH and Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: (a) entire management team change during the year as part of strategic reorganization; (b) tax treatment of Rs 50 lakh stamp duty and Form SH-7 filing fees for authorized share capital increase claimed as revenue expenditure relying on judicial precedent; (c) all employees separated during the year, gratuity obligations fully settled, defined benefit liability stands at Nil, zero active headcount as of March 31, 2026.

key_risks: Delayed regulatory compliances under SEBI LODR resulting in fines from BSE
Delay in submission of Structured Digital Database (SDD) compliance report to BSE
Complete separation of all employees and zero headcount as of March 31, 2026
Tax uncertainty on treatment of Rs 50 lakh stamp duty and filing fees as revenue expenditure
Strategic transition risk from logistics to dairy sector with acquisitions completed after FY end
facts.related_party_note: During the financial year under review, the Company entered into transactions with related parties as defined under Section 2(76) of the Companies Act, 2013, which fall within the purview of Section 188. Details are disclosed in the Financial Statements forming part of this Annual Report.
